scope.image_decode: all successful logo responses; local listed photos plus live failing Bristol file

limitations: No connected browser: visual interaction, mobile layout, keyboard navigation, actual browser downloads and Core Web Vitals not measured.
HTTP200 photo availability does not prove correct subject matter; only targeted content inspection performed.
Local and deployed key manifests match; deployed client bundle contains audited loading/export logic; complete server-source identity not independently attested.
Security source findings not exploited; advisory applicability needs triage.

findings.title: 22 listed universities have no assets
findings.evidence: Live icon APIs redirect to retired Clearbit; brand APIs return zero logos and photos; full-logo endpoints return404. Matching local asset folders contain no files.
findings.recommendation: Add verified assets or clearly mark unsupported schools; do not route users into empty builders.

findings.title: Retired Clearbit fallback
findings.evidence: 27 of49 icons decode; remaining22 redirect to logo.clearbit.com. Public service DNS fails and vendor confirms retirement on2025-12-01.
findings.recommendation: Use curated local school icons and an initials fallback.

findings.title: Reading root record has broken logo
findings.evidence: General Reading record has zero variants and fullLogo returns404. Reading University and Henley Business School each have seven valid variants. Root logo discovery is not recursive.
findings.recommendation: Select explicit default campus or merge campus-aware manifests; regenerate cache.

findings.title: UCL stale photo manifest
findings.evidence: 13of15 cached photos return404; six local photos exist, including four absent from cached listing. Default cached photo is broken.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild manifest from existing approved images; validate URLs at build time.

findings.title: USN and Innlandet lack all campus photos
findings.evidence: All eight USN campus records and all six Innlandet campus records return no photos, as do their general records. Logos work.
findings.recommendation: Add campus photos and expose upload even when no gallery exists.

findings.title: BI general record has stale images
findings.evidence: Bergen.jpg and hardangerfjorden.jpeg return404 in general BI record; campus-specific lists passed HTTP availability.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the general manifest from current campus records.

findings.title: Bristol AVIF fails export decoder
findings.evidence: University-of-Bristol-Takes-the-Top-Spot-for-Student-Satisfaction.avif returns200 but Sharp fails decoding. Live bytes equal local bytes. Browser decoding was not tested.
findings.recommendation: Replace or re-encode from a healthy original and add image-decoding validation.

findings.title: Incorrect Imperial photo
findings.evidence: 40,119,787-byte painting named Victor_Meirelles…Museu_Imperial… is exposed as an Imperial College campus image. Visually inspected.
findings.recommendation: Remove irrelevant image and manually curate institution/campus accuracy.

findings.title: Logo failure persists after source change
findings.evidence: SmartLogo sets err=true and returns null thereafter; no reset when src changes.
findings.recommendation: Reset error on source change; show recoverable fallback; test switching from broken to valid campus/logo.

findings.title: Downloads silently omit failed assets
findings.evidence: Controlled request with missing image and logo returned200 and plain PNG. UCL default export also returned200 despite missing photo.
findings.recommendation: Validate required assets, return clear422 error, and show actionable recovery.

findings.title: Preview/export layout divergence
findings.evidence: Live controlled render tests across layouts0–8 all produced1584x396 PNGs. Layout3 renders a photo although preview has solid brand background. Layout8 lacks UCL stripe implementation. Layout4/7 omit preview dark overlays. Text positioning/fonts differ in API tests, but text editor is currently absent in UI.
findings.recommendation: Use one shared layout definition; add rendered-output regression tests for all layouts.

findings.title: Heavy full-resolution gallery loading
findings.evidence: Builder eagerly loads originals into44x28 thumbnails and hidden hover previews. UiA Kristiansand14 images total89.9MB; Grimstad12 total43.7MB; Imperial5 total41.48MB. Totals are payload sizes, not browser timing measurements.
findings.recommendation: Create88–160px thumbnails and1600–2000px preview/export derivatives; lazy-load gallery and defer hover images.

findings.title: Homepage showcase payload
findings.evidence: Four eager showcase PNGs total4,150,110bytes. Local1000px WebP quality80 trial totals107,368bytes (97.4% reduction). Trial not deployed and visual quality still needs acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Serve responsive WebP/AVIF with dimensions; lazy-load below-fold gallery; prioritize hero only.

findings.title: Avoidable dynamic logo work
findings.evidence: Icon route resizes on every request with no-store. Full logos run file discovery/background analysis and Sharp transforms; brand route forced dynamic though serving fixed JSON.
findings.recommendation: Precompute versioned icons/logos/manifests and serve from CDN; remove timestamp cache-busting.

findings.title: Unnecessary onboarding before core action
findings.evidence: Country, degree/year, industry steps precede school search; Skip exists, but each manual opening starts at step1. Several one-campus universities still require campus step.
findings.recommendation: Lead with school search; make profile questions optional; auto-select sole campus; remember school.

findings.title: Empty galleries also hide upload
findings.evidence: Upload control is nested inside brand.images.length>0.
findings.recommendation: Always expose upload and show honest empty-state messaging.

findings.title: Advertised headline editor absent
findings.evidence: setText is declared but never used and no headline input is rendered, while homepage/how-to copy advertises personalised text.
findings.recommendation: Restore editor with shared export typography or update promises.

findings.title: Weak error/accessibility handling
findings.evidence: Brand fetch errors only log to console; invalid manual school input reaches empty builder. Modal lacks dialog semantics, Escape handler and focus management; photo/logo/color buttons lack accessible names. Browser/keyboard verification pending.
findings.recommendation: Add accessible dialog/search controls, visible errors/retry and reject unsupported freeform submissions.

findings.title: Campus switch retains custom photo and styling
findings.evidence: Changing campus resets photo/logo indices but leaves customImage and tint/layout state. A previously uploaded photo can override newly selected campus photos.
findings.recommendation: Reset or explicitly preserve customization with clear UI indication.

findings.title: Dependency advisory findings
findings.evidence: npm audit reports15 affected dependency entries:1critical,11high,2moderate,1low; includes Next16.1.6 and Sharp. Counts include development/transitive dependencies and do not establish exploitability of each advisory in production.
findings.recommendation: Update dependencies with migration review and targeted build/export validation; inspect npm-audit.json.

findings.title: Render endpoint accepts arbitrary fetch destinations
findings.evidence: Source review: imageUrl/logoUrl passed to server fetch without host allowlist, request timeout, image byte limits or rate limiting. No exploit attempted.
findings.recommendation: Accept manifest asset IDs or validated uploads; restrict destinations and redirects; bound bytes/dimensions/time and rate-limit.

findings.title: Image endpoint path validation inadequate
findings.evidence: root parameter controls basePath, and startsWith(basePath) does not prove containment beneath an immutable approved asset root. No nonpublic-file retrieval attempted.
findings.recommendation: Allowlist roots and validate resolved paths with path.relative against fixed roots, plus file type and size checks.

findings.title: Shopify route lacks authentication
findings.evidence: Source review: GET accepts customerId and can return email using admin token; POST can update customer data. Impact depends on whether production credentials remain configured; not tested against customer data.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused integration or require authentication and per-customer authorization.

findings.title: Privacy description contradicts processing
findings.evidence: Policy states banners processed locally, while builder posts assets to server; custom image becomes base64 request body and render route logs body. Ads script also loads globally.
findings.recommendation: Describe actual processing and retention accurately; remove full-body logging and review third-party disclosure.

findings.title: Quality checks
findings.evidence: TypeScript noEmit passed; ESLint reported39errors and137warnings. No build or interactive browser test performed.
findings.recommendation: Resolve lint failures and add manifest, decoding, fallback and export consistency checks.
